name: smara-release-agent
description: Custom workflow untuk proses release Smara CLI: preflight check, build frontend, cross-platform build, checksum, git tag, dan publish GitHub release.

agents.description: Memeriksa kesiapan release: git status clean, VERSION file valid, tag belum ada, dan dependency terpasang.

tasks.description: Validasi semua prasyarat sebelum memulai proses release.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
echo "=== Release Preflight Check ==="
echo "Version: $VERSION"

# 1. Check git status
echo
echo "--- Git Status ---"
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  echo "❌ FAIL: Working directory not clean"
  git status --short
  echo "Commit or stash changes first."
  exit 1
fi
echo "✓ Git working directory clean"

# 2. Check VERSION format
echo
echo "--- Version Check ---"
if ! echo "$VERSION" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'; then
  echo "❌ FAIL: Invalid VERSION format: $VERSION (expected X.Y.Z)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "✓ Version format valid: $VERSION"

# 3. Check tag doesn't exist yet
echo
echo "--- Tag Check ---"
if git tag -l "v$VERSION" | grep -q "v$VERSION"; then
  echo "❌ FAIL: Tag v$VERSION already exists"
  exit 1
fi
echo "✓ Tag v$VERSION does not exist yet"

# 4. Check required tools
echo
echo "--- Tool Check ---"
for tool in go make git tar sha256sum; do
  if command -v $tool >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "✓ $tool available"
  else
    echo "❌ FAIL: $tool not found"
    exit 1
  fi
done

# 5. Check gh CLI (for GitHub release)
if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "✓ gh (GitHub CLI) available"
  gh auth status 2>&1 | head -3
else
  echo "⚠ gh CLI not found (GitHub release step will need manual)"
fi

# 6. Check npm for frontend build
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "✓ npm available"
else
  echo "❌ FAIL: npm not found (needed for frontend build)"
  exit 1
fi

echo
echo "✅ All preflight checks passed for v$VERSION"

agents.description: Build frontend React (Vite) dan sync ke internal/web/dist untuk go:embed.

tasks.description: Install npm deps, build Vite frontend, dan copy ke internal/web/dist.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
echo "=== Build Frontend (Vite) ==="

echo "--- Install npm dependencies ---"
cd web
npm install --prefer-offline 2>&1 | tail -3

echo
echo "--- Build Vite ---"
npx vite build 2>&1

echo
echo "--- Sync to internal/web/dist ---"
cd ..
rm -rf internal/web/dist
cp -r web/dist internal/web/dist
echo "✓ Frontend synced to internal/web/dist"

echo
echo "--- Verify dist ---"
ls -lh web/dist/ 2>/dev/null || ls -lh web/dist/assets/ 2>/dev/null
echo
ls -lh internal/web/dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo "✅ Frontend build complete"

agents.description: Build binary cross-platform (linux/amd64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64, windows/amd64) dan buat arsip release.

tasks.description: Compile Go binary untuk 4 platform dan buat arsip tar.gz/zip.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
BINARY=smara
GOFLAGS="-trimpath"
LDFLAGS="-s -w -X main.version=$VERSION"
PLATFORMS="linux/amd64 darwin/amd64 darwin/arm64 windows/amd64"

echo "=== Cross-Platform Build ==="
echo "Version: $VERSION"
echo

rm -rf dist
mkdir -p dist

for platform in $PLATFORMS; do
  os=$(echo $platform | cut -d/ -f1)
  arch=$(echo $platform | cut -d/ -f2)
  ext=""
  if [ "$os" = "windows" ]; then ext=".exe"; fi
  target_name="${BINARY}-v${VERSION}-${os}-${arch}"

  echo "Building $os/$arch..."
  GOOS=$os GOARCH=$arch CGO_ENABLED=0 go build $GOFLAGS -ldflags "$LDFLAGS" -o "dist/${target_name}${ext}" ./cmd/smara/

  if [ "$os" = "windows" ]; then
    cd dist && zip "${target_name}.zip" "${target_name}.exe" && rm "${target_name}.exe" && cd ..
  else
    cd dist && tar -czf "${target_name}.tar.gz" "${target_name}" && rm "${target_name}" && cd ..
  fi
  echo "  ✓ $target_name"
done

echo
echo "--- Build Artifacts ---"
ls -lh dist/
echo
echo "✅ Cross-platform build complete"

agents.description: Generate SHA256 checksums untuk semua arsip release.

tasks.description: Buat file SHA256SUMS.txt untuk verifikasi integritas artifact.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
echo "=== Generate Checksums ==="

cd dist
sha256sum *.tar.gz *.zip 2>/dev/null > SHA256SUMS.txt || shasum -a 256 *.tar.gz *.zip > SHA256SUMS.txt

echo "--- SHA256SUMS.txt ---"
cat SHA256SUMS.txt
echo
echo "✅ Checksums generated"

agents.description: Verifikasi semua artifact: file ada, ukuran wajar, binary bisa dijalankan (Linux local).

tasks.description: Validasi kelengkapan dan integritas semua artifact release.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
echo "=== Verify Artifacts ==="

EXPECTED_FILES=(
  "dist/smara-v${VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz"
  "dist/smara-v${VERSION}-darwin-amd64.tar.gz"
  "dist/smara-v${VERSION}-darwin-arm64.tar.gz"
  "dist/smara-v${VERSION}-windows-amd64.zip"
  "dist/SHA256SUMS.txt"
)

ALL_OK=true
for f in "${EXPECTED_FILES[@]}"; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$f" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "✓ $f ($SIZE bytes)"
  else
    echo "❌ MISSING: $f"
    ALL_OK=false
  fi
done

# Verify checksums
echo
echo "--- Checksum Verification ---"
cd dist
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt

# Test Linux binary
echo
echo "--- Smoke Test (Linux binary) ---"
cd /tmp
tar -xzf "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI/dist/smara-v${VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz"
./smara-v${VERSION}-linux-amd64 --version 2>&1 || ./smara-v${VERSION}-linux-amd64 version 2>&1 || echo "(version flag test skipped)"
rm -f smara-v${VERSION}-linux-amd64

if [ "$ALL_OK" = true ]; then
  echo
echo "✅ All artifacts verified successfully"
else
  echo "❌ Some artifacts missing!"
  exit 1
fi

agents.description: Commit semua perubahan (dist, frontend), buat tag versi, dan push ke remote.

tasks.description: Commit release artifacts, buat annotated tag, dan push ke origin.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
TAG="v$VERSION"

echo "=== Git Tag & Push ==="
echo "Version: $VERSION"
echo "Tag: $TAG"

# Stage all changes
git add -A
git status --short

# Commit if there are changes
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  git commit -m "release: v${VERSION}

- Cross-platform build (linux/darwin/windows)
- Frontend rebuild
- Updated dist artifacts"
  echo "✓ Release committed"
else
  echo "✓ No changes to commit"
fi

# Create annotated tag
git tag -a "$TAG" -m "Release $TAG"
echo "✓ Tag created: $TAG"

# Push commit and tag
git push origin HEAD
git push origin "$TAG"
echo "✓ Pushed to origin"

echo
echo "✅ Git tag and push complete for $TAG"

agents.description: Publish GitHub Release menggunakan gh CLI dengan semua artifact dan release notes.

tasks.description: Buat GitHub Release dengan semua artifact dan auto-generated release notes.

tool_args.command:
set -e
cd "/home/cahya/2026/Smara CLI"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
TAG="v$VERSION"

echo "=== Publish GitHub Release ==="

if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "⚠ gh CLI not available. Skipping GitHub Release."
  echo "Create release manually at:"
  REMOTE=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  REPO=$(echo $REMOTE | sed 's/.*github.com[:/]\(.*\)\.git/\1/')
  echo "  https://github.com/$REPO/releases/new?tag=$TAG"
  echo
  echo "Upload these files:"
  ls -1 dist/
  exit 0
fi

# Check gh auth
if ! gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "⚠ gh CLI not authenticated. Run: gh auth login"
  exit 1
fi

# Generate release notes from git log
PREV_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD~1 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
  NOTES=$(git log --pretty=format:"- %s (%h)" ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD 2>/dev/null)
else
  NOTES=$(git log --pretty=format:"- %s (%h)" -20 2>/dev/null)
fi

RELEASE_NOTES="## Smara CLI $TAG

### Installation

**Linux/macOS (curl):**
\`\`\`bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*github.com[:/]\(.*\)\.git/\1/' || echo 'cahyaiqbaldev/smara-cli')/main/install.sh | bash
\`\`\`

**Windows (PowerShell):**
\`\`\`powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*github.com[:/]\(.*\)\.git/\1/' || echo 'cahyaiqbaldev/smara-cli')/main/install.ps1 | iex
\`\`\`

### Changelog
$NOTES

### Assets
| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| Linux amd64 | smara-v${VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz |
| macOS Intel | smara-v${VERSION}-darwin-amd64.tar.gz |
| macOS Apple Silicon | smara-v${VERSION}-darwin-arm64.tar.gz |
| Windows | smara-v${VERSION}-windows-amd64.zip |
| Checksums | SHA256SUMS.txt |"

# Create release with all artifacts
gh release create "$TAG" \
  --title "Smara CLI $TAG" \
  --notes "$RELEASE_NOTES" \
  dist/*.tar.gz dist/*.zip dist/SHA256SUMS.txt

echo
echo "✅ GitHub Release published: $TAG"
echo "View at:"
gh release view "$TAG" --web 2>/dev/null || true
